name: Move Jammer - Armor
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. It can also affect the Armor of enemy STs.

61207.name: Movement Enhancement I - Armor
61207.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
In combat, the enemy's Armor <color=#F74848>-50%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
